blocks.title: Computer programming
blocks.text: Computer programming hidayaat ka aisa majmooa banane ka amal hai jo computer ko batata hai ke koi kaam kaise karna hai, aisi programming language mein likha jata hai jise computer samajh aur chala sake.

Yeh kisi dost ko apne ghar ka raasta batane jaisa hai: aap ko saaf aur durust hona chahiye ta ke dost bhatak na jaye. Isi tarah program computer ko khaas kaam poore karne ke liye saaf aur durust hidayaat deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Program ki hidayaat saaf aur durust kyun honi chahiyein?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke computer un par bilkul waisa hi chalta hai; mubham ya ghalat hidayat, dost ko ghalat raasta batane ki tarah, ghalat nateeja deti hai.

items: Programming: aisi zaban mein durust hidayaat likhna jise computer chala sake, dost ko saaf raasta batane ki tarah.
